privileged_info_for_vlm: The contract must be named 'Annual Maintenance Agreement 2024' for the account 'Westfield Industrial Supplies'. Required values: Status='Signed', Start Date='07/01/2024' (or 2024-07-01), End Date='06/30/2025' (or 2025-06-30), Total Contract Value='48000.00'. The description must mention 'Annual preventive maintenance contract covering all industrial equipment at the Westfield facility. Includes quarterly inspections and emergency callout support.'
